Zacchaeus in Jericho, Luke 19. A short man climbed a tree just to see Jesus, and the Lord called him by name, Come down, I must abide at your house. People grumbled, but Jesus came to seek and to save the lost. Zacchaeus made things right and gave to the poor. Jesus knows your name too. You are not too small, too late, or too messy to come down and meet Him today.
